lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters exhibiting semi-regular spacing across the mid-lateral flank, with increasing density observed towards the posterior (left) field of view.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated intensity intersecting with the horizontal blob rows, forming a visible grid-like coordinate system in the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature across the upper third of the flank, defined by a distinct pixel intensity gradient with high-luminance values on the dorsal side and low-luminance values on the ventral side.
